HOW IT WORKS

One call. Three simple steps.

Helpful on the phone. Useful after you hang up.

  1. 01

    Your customer calls.

    Your AI employee answers, introduces itself and listens to what the caller needs.

    “Hi, I’d like to book a visit.”
  2. 02

    It helps with the request.

    It answers approved questions, collects the details and helps arrange the next step.

    “What day works best for you?”
  3. 03

    The follow-up gets handled.

    With your tools connected, it can save the details, send a message or notify your team.

    The right details, in the right hands.

You decide what it can do and when a person should take over.

A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT BE WONDERING

Good questions.
Clear answers.

What is an AI voice agent?

It is an AI assistant that can speak with people on the phone. We give it a clear role, such as a receptionist or booking assistant, and train it on the business information and tasks you approve.

What can it do after a call?

Depending on the tools we connect, it can save enquiry details, create a booking, send a confirmation or give your team a follow-up task. We agree on those actions with you before they go live.

Will callers know they are speaking to AI?

We design the introduction to make that clear. The example conversations on this site show the assistant introducing itself as AI before helping with the request.

Can a caller speak to a person?

Yes. We agree on when to transfer a call, take a message or request a callback. If your team is unavailable, the assistant explains the next step rather than promising an immediate transfer.

Can it work with our existing phone number and software?

We review your current phone setup, calendar, booking tools and customer records first. Then we confirm what can be connected and how calls should be routed.

How do we get started?

We learn about your calls, choose the first job for your AI employee and connect the tools it needs. You review example calls and follow-up actions with us before launch.
